question: In 1950, which Russian astronomer revised the 'nebular hypothesis', proposing that the sun is surrounded by a solar nebula consisting mainly of hydrogen and helium as well as dust?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Otto Schmidt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nebular hypothesis:-**

 
 
• Otto Schmidt was a Russian scientist who proposed the revised nebular hypothesis in 1950.
 
• The revised hypothesis proposed that the sun is surrounded by a solar nebula consisting mainly of hydrogen and helium, as well as dust.
 
• This hypothesis is widely accepted today and forms the basis of our understanding of the formation of our solar system.
